name: Hitomi Zaka
source: A love story about a group of teenagers. You play as a guy who hangs out at a coffee house a lot and meets a girl. Said guy proceeds to go on dates with the girl and they get wrapped up in their friend's drama every so often.
translation: 讲述了一群青少年的爱情故事。你扮演一个经常去咖啡馆闲逛并遇到一个女孩的男人。那个男人继续和那个女孩约会，他们时不时地沉浸在朋友的戏剧中。
